record.title_md: [Informal Conjecture on R(n;r,s) vs R'(n;r,s) near Turán density](https://arxiv.org/abs/2206.11371)

dossier_meta.catalog_title: Informal Conjecture on R(n;r,s) vs R'(n;r,s) near Turán density
dossier_meta.statement_text: We clearly have $R(n; r, s) \geq R'(n; r, s)$ and we believe that this estimate should be close to an equality when $s/r$ is close to the Turán density $1 - \frac{1}{n-1}$.
dossier_meta.context_text: The authors introduce the variant $R'(n;r,s)$, defined as the minimum $N$ such that every $(r,s)$-coloring of $K_N$ yields a color class with chromatic number at least $n$. They observe that $R(n;r,s) \geq R'(n;r,s)$ always holds, and that for the special case $s = r-1$ near-equality is confirmed by prior work of Alon et al. [1]. The informal belief is stated in Section 4 while studying the fixed-$n$ regime.
